description: World Science Output by Country and Field. The shape of world research in one API, counted from every record in OpenAlex (snapshot 2026-10-14, 464,765,485 works). Routes: /gaps (year, min_population, limit, offset); /rank (year, by, min_population, limit, offset); /fields (year, limit, offset); /rising (country, subfield, field, min_papers, sort, limit, offset); /subfields (q, limit, offset); /countries/{iso2} (from, to, limit, offset); /fields/{field_id} (from, to, limit, offset). Paid $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /gaps, /rank, /fields, /rising, /subfields, /countries/{iso2}, /fields/{field_id}. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: science
